recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13314; any future changes to the current nsd-3 invariant should be handled under the later authoritative-identifier issue family, not this replacedBy-removal issue.
issue_request: FHIR-13314 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3. It raised concern that NamingSystem.replacedBy was a server-local resource reference and asked whether it should instead be a fixed URL tied to NamingSystem.uniqueId. The accepted resolution removed NamingSystem.replacedBy entirely and removed the associated nsd-3 constraint.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 06130884835bbf984b96075033d9cca5cca713de (#13314 - Remove NamingSystem.replacedBy, svn revision 12723) deleted the replaced NamingSystem example, removed the NamingSystem.replacedBy element, removed the replaced-by search parameter, and removed the old nsd-3 invariant whose expression was replacedBy.empty() or status = 'retired'.
additional_context: NamingSystem is active in the current build. The current StructureDefinition still uses the key nsd-3, but it is attached to NamingSystem.uniqueId.authoritative and enforces the later FHIR-27056 rule that only one authoritative identifier exists for a type/period combination. FHIR-29704 later rejected adding NamingSystem.replacedBy back, supporting the continued absence of the element.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source hunk was needed because source/namingsystem contains no replacedBy element, replaced-by search parameter, example-replaced file, or old replacedBy/status invariant. Removing the current nsd-3 would incorrectly undo later published authoritative-identifier work.

related_jiras.note: Added NamingSystem.uniqueId.authoritative and the current authoritative-identifier constraint that reuses the nsd-3 key.
Rejected adding NamingSystem.replacedBy back in R5 after the FHIR-13314 removal.
